teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! this is Karman from Hong Kong. I have currently moved to a small town in the Southwest of Spain and I am now learning Spanish. I am a registered English Language Teacher and have an honour degree in Education, major in English language teaching. I studied in England and I have a master degree in Linguistics. I have been teaching English as a second language for about 8 years. Since I graduated, I worked as an ESL teacher in a few secondary schools and tertiary education institutes and language centres in Hong Kong. I also work as a freelance interpreter and translator in a school magazine. I had experience conducting various types of lessons to students at all levels, including preparation courses for public examinations, phonics & pronunciations classes, training for public speaking and one-to-one tutorials for workplace communications. Besides English, my native language is Cantonese and I can speak Mandarin fluently. I have an intermediate level of Spanish. As an experienced second language learner myself, I believe I am well aware of the challenges and frustrations English learners face. That is why my lessons are going to be student-oriented and engaging in order to help you to learn. The teaching materials will be tailor-made and carefully chosen to cater for your needs and objectives. Also, the lessons are going to make use of various types of authentic materials, including music, TV series, newspaper, news reports and of course games. I will employ different kinds of teaching methodology in the lessons, including role-play, practice of interactions in some daily-life contexts (i.e. café, supermarket or job interviews), learning grammar in an interesting way and putting forward your arguments in writing. If you are interested, send me a message with what you want to achieve and let me know if I can help with your learning. Hope you to see you soon.

teacher_info.intro: Hi, I'm Shuni. Born in Indonesia to an English-speaking family, I'm a native speaker of both English and Indonesian. Later, I learned Japanese as a second language. This journey has given me deep insight into the differences between acquiring a native language naturally and learning a second language. When I learned English and Indonesian, I didn't start with grammar—no baby does. However, learning Japanese began with grammar. This dual perspective allows me to teach grammar from the basics and understand the confusing structures that native speakers often take for granted. At the same time, as a native speaker, I can guide learners to speak naturally and authentically.

pro_course_detail.title: Learning English through Stories
pro_course_detail.description:
If you enjoy stories, this class is perfect for you!
物語が好きな方に、このクラスはぴったりです！

READ
Goal: Understand the story
目標: 物語を理解する
After I confirm your lesson request, I’ll send you a short story to read before class. But don’t worry. If you don’t have time to read it beforehand, you’ll have a few minutes to read it during class. At this stage, you won’t be required to read the story aloud.
レッスンリクエストを確認後、事前に読んで頂けるように物語をお送りします。でもご安心下さい。事前に読む時間が取れなかった場合、レッスン中に数分間で読んで頂ける時間を設けます。この段階では物語を声に出して読む必要はありません。

ASSESS
Goal: Proof of understanding
目標: 理解の確認
Since I can’t read minds, I’ll ask a few questions about the story to ensure you’ve understood it. Don’t worry. It won’t feel like an interrogation! We’ll go through the questions in a fun and interactive way. If there are parts of the story you didn’t quite grasp, this will be the perfect time to discuss them.
物語をしっかり理解しているか確認する為、いくつか質問をさせて頂きます。でもご安心下さい。それを取り調べのようにはしません！楽しくインタラクティブに進めていきます。もし理解しきれていない部分があれば、このタイミングで一緒に解決しましょう。

TELL
Goal: Demonstrate understanding
目標: 理解を表現する
Here’s your chance to retell the story in your own words. Don’t worry. You don’t need to memorize it. As long as you’re not reading word for word, you’re welcome to refer to the text while telling the story.
今度は、物語を自分の言葉で話してみる時間です。でもご安心ください。物語を暗記する必要はありません。逐語的に読んでいない限り、テキストを見ながら物語を話しても大丈夫です。

EXERCISE
Goal: Improve understanding
目標: 理解の向上
At the end of the class, I’ll provide you with a homework assignment to complete before our next session. But don’t worry. If you have a busy week and can’t get it done, you’re still welcome in the next class.
クラスの最後には、次のレッスンまでに提出して頂く宿題をお渡しします。でもご安心下さい。もし1週間が忙しくて宿題が出来なくても、そのまま次のクラスに来てください。

This is my self-developed RATE Method!
これが私の開発した RATEメソッド です！

Lastly, don’t worry about the difficulty level of the stories. I have a variety of stories ranging from beginner to advanced levels. I promise you won’t feel bored, and I certainly won’t give you a headache.

pro_course_detail.description:
This class is perfect for you if you’re looking to practice your English-speaking skills while receiving feedback or simply want to talk about a topic while improving your English.
You’re welcome to propose your preferred format for our conversations. For example, you can tell me a story. It doesn’t need to be a true story, nor grammatically perfect. Alternatively, if you prefer a two-way interaction, we can engage in role-playing or have a discussion. You can also ask me questions, and I’ll answer, giving you a chance to practice your listening skills.

No matter the format you choose, my teaching style prioritizes your flow of thought. I won’t interrupt you while you’re speaking. In role-play scenarios, I’ll stay in character and let the conversation progress naturally. While you talk, I’ll take notes. Once you’re finished, I’ll provide constructive feedback.

Even if it takes you extra time to form a single English sentence, I’ll patiently wait without jumping in to complete it for you. Instead, I’ll encourage you to work through it at your own pace. Over time, this practice will help you become faster and more confident in forming sentences.

会話の形式は自由に提案して下さい。例えば、何か物語を話していただく事も出来ます。それが実際にあった話である必要はありませんし、文法的に完璧である必要もありません。また、双方向のやり取りをご希望であれば、ロールプレイをしたり、ディスカッションを行ったりすることも可能です。質問をしていただき、それに私が答える形でリスニングの練習をする事も出来ます。

הרעיון של השיעור הוא פשוט לדבר – וללמוד את כל מה שצריך תוך כדי. בצורה הזו תלמדו את הדברים שהכי מעניינים אתכם – הדברים שבא לכם לדבר עליהם. נגלה מילים חדשות ומבנים חדשים, ונכתוב אותם בקובץ גוגל משותף שאליו תוכלו לחזור ולהתאמן מתי שתרצו. תקבלו שיעורי בית לקריאה, כתיבה והקלטה, כדי לחזק את הידע שלכם בין השיעורים :)

pro_course_detail.title: Together Is Better :) – Lessons for 2 students 👬
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to learn Hebrew with a friend or a family member? Great idea! Not only is it more fun, it also pays off :)

Find a fun partner for your Hebrew lessons (they can be at a different place on the globe, of course), and I will take care of the rest. And don't worry if you are at different levels! We will make it work :)

pro_course_detail.title: יחד זה הכי טוב :) – שיעורים לשני תלמידים ויותר 👬
pro_course_detail.description:
רוצים ללמוד אנגלית עם חבר או בן משפחה? רעיון מעולה! זה לא רק יותר כיף, זה גם יותר משתלם...

בחרו את השותפ/ה שמתאימ/ה לכם (הם יכולים להיות בכל מקום בעולם), ואני אטפל בכל השאר. ולא צריך לדאוג אם אתם לא באותה רמה! אני אדאג שזה יעבוד :)

pro_course_detail.title: On The Phone 📳
pro_course_detail.description: No video, no reading, only talking! This is an audio-only lesson, designed for students whose language skills are advanced enough - or for those who want to challenge themselves. With only audio, you can be anywhere you like and focus entirely on two crucial skills: speaking and listening. Plus, since no video is required, the price of this lesson is reduced! :)

pro_course_detail.title: אנגלית בטלפון 📳
pro_course_detail.description:
בלי וידאו, בלי קריאה – רק דיבור!

שיעור טלפוני ללא וידאו, שמיועד לתלמידים ברמה מתקדמת – או למי שרוצים לאתגר את עצמם. השיעורים ללא וידאו מאפשרים לכם להיות בכל מקום שתבחרו, לנטרל הסחות, ולהתמקד באופן מלא בשני כישורים חשובים: דיבור והבנת הנשמע. בנוסף, מכיוון שאין צורך בווידאו, המחיר של השיעור מופחת :)
